caption: The video captures a close-up view of split and charred firewood logs in the foreground against a blurred green backdrop. A wedge-shaped log sits on the left, a flat-topped log occupies the center, and a blackened log with curled bark tips the right, all remaining fixed. Orange flames continuously lick the right edge and base of the left log, flickering and shifting in height frame to frame. Out-of-focus flame shapes glow and vary in intensity in the upper-left and center background, consistent with ongoing combustion. Thin white smoke wisps drift upward, gathering and growing denser along the right side near the charred log. Toward the later frames, a flame at the bottom-left base of the left log brightens and enlarges. The framing stays constant, so the visible motion comes from the dancing fire and rising smoke.
